questions.Description:
Carry out the following operations.
a) Direct operation of a Single Acting and Double acting Cylinder using Pneumatic kit
b) Direct operation of a Double Acting Cylinder using Hydraulic kit

Carry out the following operations.
a) Operation of a Single Acting Cylinder controlled from two different positions using Shuttle Valve using Pneumatic kit
b) Direct operation of a Hydraulic motor.

Carry out the following operations.
a) Operation of a Double Acting Cylinder with quick return using quick exhaust valve using Pneumatic kit
b) Controlling the speed of a Double Acting Cylinder using metering-in and metering-out type control using Hydraulic kit

Carry out the following operations.
a) Controlling the speed of a Double Acting Cylinder using metering – in and metering – out controls using Pneumatic kit
b) Controlling the speed of hydraulic motor using metering – in and metering-out control Sequencing of two cylinders using Sequence Valve using Hydraulic kit

Carry out the following operations.
a) Automatic operation of a Double Acting Cylinder in single cycle and multi cycle using limit switch and memory valve using Pneumatic kit
b) Direct operation of a Double Acting Cylinder using Hydraulic kit
